subject: VP/CTO intro window request + technical deep-dive scheduling
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Chen <anna@novalink.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & request: VP/CTO intro + technical deep-dive windows

Hi Anna — great conversation this morning. Thanks for sharing the priorities and the latency/cost targets you need to hit for the personalization pilot. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: Novalink wants a low-latency inference path for short conversational prompts (median latency < 150ms for 512 tokens) and predictable unit cost around target. There will be two gating checks: executive alignment on business risk/SLA, and an infra deep-dive with your architecture/ML infra leads.

- Ask: Can we schedule a 30m VP/CTO intro + 60m technical deep-dive within the next 10 business days to unblock a scoped POC? The VP/CTO intro will be primarily to confirm success metrics and procurement runway; the deep-dive will cover integration pattern, network/security attachments, and an initial performance runbook.

Proposed windows (PT):
1) Tue Nov 24, 10:00–11:30am PT (VP intro 10:00–10:30, tech deep-dive 10:30–11:30)
2) Thu Nov 26, 8:30–10:00am PT (same split)

If those don't work, please share a couple of slots that match your CTO/Vice President calendar. I attached a short discovery notes PDF and a one-pager we use for exec briefings.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary stub)

Thanks — happy to own scheduling. Once we lock the slot I'll share an agenda and a brief (slide) pack for the execs.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear recap. We are definitely interested in moving to a scoped POC. Quick responses: 

- Both proposed windows are plausible, but our CTO (Vikram) is only available on Tue Nov 24 at 10:00am PT. VP of Product can join if the slot is fixed.
- For the technical deep-dive, please expect our ML infra lead (Sana Patel) and one backend engineer (James Lee) — they'd like 60 minutes to dig into networking, tokenization pipeline, and expected throughput.

Can you send a calendar invite for Tue Nov 24, 10:00–11:30am PT? Also please include a short agenda and any pre-reads (1–2 slides) so the execs know the intended outcomes.

Anna
Director of Product
Novalink Inc.
